description: Declarative business-context rules. Each rule can adjust confidence, cap the response, or raise priority. Rules never raise a decision to AUTO_REMEDIATE.

rules.description: Marketing/media buckets are meant to be read publicly; blind auto-blocking would break a website, so a human decides.
rules.reason: Bucket is tagged DataClass=PUBLIC, so public readability may be intentional. ASPARe alerts instead of auto-blocking.

rules.description: Scratch/cache buckets hold re-creatable data; missing versioning is low value.
rules.reason: Purpose indicates re-creatable data (scratch/cache); versioning adds cost with little protection.

rules.description: Regulated data raises priority; never lowers a finding.
rules.reason: Bucket holds a regulated data class, so the same weakness has a larger blast radius.
